BEP_3.title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
BEP_3.core: Metainfo file (.torrent) → tracker → peers → pieces → reassemble

mapping.tracker: Golgi server (coordinates but doesn't do the work)
mapping.pieces: amino acids (file broken into digestible chunks, typically 256KB)

BEP_5.title: DHT Protocol (Distributed Hash Table)
BEP_5.core: Kademlia-based peer discovery without central tracker
BEP_5.mapping: MYCELIUM — underground fungal network. Decentralized. No single point of failure. Each node knows a few others. Together they know everything.

BEP_9.title: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files (ut_metadata)
